title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): UpdateAuditFields Method on DataTransfer is now in Cloud scope
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) now makes the UpdateAuditFields method on DataTransfer available in Cloud scope, allowing developers to control audit field updates when transferring data between tables during upgrades and installations.
key_points: UpdateAuditFields method on DataTransfer was previously OnPrem-only, now available in Cloud scope in BC27
DataTransfer is a language construct for fast upgrade code that moves or copies field data between tables
Audit fields (SystemCreatedAt, SystemCreatedBy, SystemModifiedAt, SystemModifiedBy) track record creation and modification
UpdateAuditFields method controls whether audit fields are updated when copying data; defaults to true

quotes.text: UpdateAuditFields Method on DataTransfer is now in Cloud scope.
quotes.why_it_matters: This removes a previous restriction that limited the method to on-premises development, enabling more flexible cloud-based upgrade scenarios.

quotes.text: developers can write faster upgrade code when they want to move a field (with data) from one table to another
quotes.why_it_matters: DataTransfer provides a performance advantage for migration scenarios compared to traditional methods.
